### The High and Holy Place
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/high-and-holy-place
Passage: Isaiah 57:14-21
Points:
- The earthly Most Holy Place served as a limited shadow of God's exalted, heavenly reality.
- Isaiah emphasizes God's transcendence and supreme holiness above all created things.
- Remarkably, the exalted Lord also chooses to dwell intimately with the contrite and humble.
- Jesus fulfills and replaces the temple, satisfying divine holiness to grant believers eternal life.
- Because condemnation is removed in Christ, believers can pursue a close relationship with God through worship, prayer, and Scripture.
